description.text: The seventh expansion of the BW series, released on 14 September 2012 and built around Team Plasma, the villains of Pokémon Black 2 and White 2. Team Plasma cards appear among Pokémon, Trainers and Energy and power each other up in what the official site called the Plasma mechanism, as with Lugia-EX [Team Plasma]. Its other Pokémon-EX are Victini-EX, Articuno-EX and Cobalion-EX. It came out with the Team Plasma Powered Deck 30 half deck. The cards are numbered to 70, with Ultra Rare Charizard, Blastoise and Random Receiver beyond that. In English most of its cards came out in Plasma Storm in February 2013.
